paragraphs: Mentioned in Kiddushin 17a; Hyman says without doubt that the name should read bar Peda. See the entry R' Yehudah ben Pedayah, and Tosafot on Chullin 124b, beginning “Rav Papa said.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: יז./קכד: give 17a/124b by the period/colon convention. The separately read Vilna Edition Tosafot 124b:21:1 begins אמר רב פפא במרודד, supporting the incipit’s Rav Papa said expansion. This supports neither Peda’s identity nor the title of the cross-reference destination.
בל״ס preserves Hyman’s without-doubt confidence in the bar-Peda correction, without adopting it into the supplied heading or authority record. Both supplied ר׳ titles remain R'.
